_fixtureNote: CONSTRUCTED 2026-10-23. Australian 10-point track rating scale (ARB, adopted December 2014). Descriptions paraphrase Racing NSW / Racing Australia wording from search snippets.

ratings.label: Good 3
ratings.description: Good track with reasonable grass coverage, little cushion

ratings.label: Good 4
ratings.description: Track with some give in it (ideal)

ratings.label: Soft 5
ratings.description: Track with a reasonable amount of give

ratings.label: Soft 7
ratings.description: More rain-affected track that will chop out

ratings.label: Heavy 8
ratings.description: Rain-affected track that will chop out

ratings.label: Heavy 9
ratings.description: Wet track getting into a squelchy area

ratings.label: Heavy 10
ratings.description: Heaviest category; maximum wetness, nearing saturation

legacyTerms.note: Dropped in 2014; Good and Heavy retained

penetrometer.method: 1 kg weight falls 1 m down a shaft driving a 1 cm^2 rod into the soil; 60 positions x 3 drops = 180 drops, averaged; higher = softer
penetrometer.timing: at least two days before the meeting and on race morning
penetrometer.combinedWith: subjective visual assessment (turf cover, give, surface moisture); correlation to rating differs by venue soil type

predictabilityByGoing.note: One private AU model's top-pick strike rate by going (small n); indicative only
